findings.reason: the reuse map would add dd_gaps.py as the owner the protocol drives, and the disposition table would read from DDGap nodes instead of a plan-local table.
findings.text: the plan's disposition table and submission protocol describe tracking DD defects and their upstream references without naming imas_codex/standard_names/dd_gaps.py, whose module docstring is "Data Dictionary defect evidence, triage, and release reconciliation" and whose DDGapKind.self_contradiction names exactly the §1 unresolved row (two facets of one quantity carrying incompatible declarations); the plan searched only the external Data Dictionary repository.

findings.reason: the plan should extend the DDGap owner (transition_dd_gap / reconcile_dd_gaps) rather than fork the same state into plan HTML, where the two copies will drift.
findings.text: the §1 row "Unresolved / Resolved upstream" statuses duplicate the DDGap lifecycle owned by imas_codex/standard_names/dd_gaps.py, which already carries DDGapStatus.upstream_issue ("The defect has been filed against the Data Dictionary"), DDGapStatus.resolved_upstream, and the upstream_url / resolved_dd_version / triage_reason fields the protocol's "record every search performed and its result" would populate.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan proposes no new module; it is a documentation-and-process plan, so there is no interface-over-behaviour surface to judge.

rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the plan adds no public definition, CLI option, MCP view or refusal family, so there is no added surface to retire or merge.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan proposes a defect-tracking protocol and disposition table for DD defects carried upstream without citing imas_codex/standard_names/dd_gaps.py, the module that already owns DD defect evidence, triage and upstream tracking.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan adds no wrapper over existing machinery; it proposes neither a layer nor an extension, so the item has no target.
